strings.name: Donald Tusk
strings.role: Prime Minister of Poland · Former European Council president
strings.summary: Tusk studied history in Gdańsk and joined the anti-communist Solidarity movement before co-founding Civic Platform. Poland’s premier in 2007–2014, he then chaired the European Council until 2019, addressing shared debt, migration and Brexit issues. Returning to domestic party leadership, he became premier again in 2023. His government pursues changes in rule of law, EU relations and security amid domestic divisions.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Former European Council president and Polish prime minister, he has long participated in EU institutions and Central and Eastern European politics.
